hero.title: Your daily orbit starts here.
hero.body: Mars Cafe is a playful neighborhood stop for carefully made coffee, warm pastries, and a little escape from Earth.

intro.title: Made for curious humans.
intro.body: We pair serious coffee craft with a retro space-diner spirit. Come for the espresso, stay for the atmosphere.

items.name: Mars Latte
items.description: Velvety espresso, cinnamon, and a warm cloud of milk.

items.name: Red Planet Mocha
items.description: Dark chocolate, espresso, and a bright coral dusting.

items.name: Orbit Pastry
items.description: Buttery, flaky, and baked fresh for the morning launch.

visit.title: Your table is waiting.
visit.body: Drop in for a slow morning, a quick refuel, or a coffee worth taking the long way for.

contact.title: Let’s plan something delicious.
contact.body: Tell us what you’re dreaming up, from a quick coffee question to a catered gathering.
